items.title: Sea of red as ASX caught in global rout
items.summary: Major miners and banks have dragged the ASX 200 down 1.79 per cent, with BHP alone shedding nearly 5 per cent as markets brace for Nvidia’s make-or-break quarterly results.

items.title: Update: US Equity Indexes Fall as Technology Leads Sector Declines Ahead of Nvidia's Results
items.summary: (Updates with index/price moves, macroeconomic data, and company news from the first paragraph.)

items.title: Bunnings cuts 230 jobs in partial offshoring of tech services
items.summary: Hardware giant Bunnings will cut 230 jobs as it looks to offshore a section of its technology department.

aus.headline: ASX Hit By Global Sell-Off
aus.body: The ASX 200 fell 1.79% as miners and banks slid, with BHP down nearly 5%.
aus.why: Many Australian super funds hold big stakes in BHP and the banks.

us.headline: Tech Drags Wall Street Lower
us.body: US share indexes slipped, led by tech stocks, ahead of Nvidia's quarterly results.
us.why: Moves on Wall Street often flow through to the ASX the next day.

biz.headline: Bunnings Cuts 230 Jobs
biz.body: Bunnings is shedding 230 roles as it moves part of its tech team offshore.
biz.why: Bunnings is one of the country's biggest retail employers.
